verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that users operate by chatting in natural language, from onboarding chat or from messaging channels. Its agent then carries out shell, browser, desktop and automation work. A hands-on report describes delegating home IT chores conversationally and completing them in a couple of hours. Missing for 10: documentation showing that the product's own administration (skill installs, config, channel setup) can be driven by natural language rather than the CLI or Control UI, and broader independent corroboration of reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Install OpenClaw, run onboarding, and chat with your AI assistant in about 5 minutes.
Run one Gateway process on your own machine and message your AI assistant from anywhere.
OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant for messaging, browser, desktop, and automation workflows.
A user handed OpenClaw home IT chores they had put off for years
